ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, the perpendicular bisector of BC intersects with the angle bisector of $\angle BAC$ at point D, with the foot of the perpendicular being point P. If $\angle BAC=84^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle BDC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct DE $\perp$ AB at point E, extending through AB, and DF $\perp$ AC at F,\\
since AD is the bisector of $\angle$BAC,\\
therefore DE = DF,\\
since DP is the perpendicular bisector of BC,\\
therefore BD = CD,\\
In right triangles $\triangle$DEB and $\triangle$DFC,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}DB=DC\\ DE=DF\end{array}\right.$,\\
therefore right $\triangle$DEB $\cong$ right $\triangle$DFC (HL).\\
therefore $\angle$BDE = $\angle$CDF,\\
therefore $\angle$BDC = $\angle$EDF,\\
since $\angle$DEB = $\angle$DFC = $90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle$EAF + $\angle$EDF = $180^\circ$,\\
since $\angle$BAC = $84^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle$BDC = $\angle$EDF = \boxed{96^\circ},

Now use the law of cosines in triangle ABC: BC²=x²+y²−2xy cos84°. Substituting x+y=2t cos42° into the expression for BD² shows BD²=BC²/(4cos²42°), so BC=2·BD·cos42°. In isosceles triangle BDC, with BD=CD and vertex angle θ=∠BDC, the base length satisfies BC=2·BD·sin(θ/2). Therefore sin(θ/2)=cos42°=sin48°, so θ/2=48° and ∠BDC=96°.

推理：已知 ∠BAC=84°，且 AD 是角平分线，所以 ∠BAD=∠DAC=42°。设 AB=x，AC=y，AD=t。因为 D 在 BC 的垂直平分线上，所以 BD=CD。

在三角形 ABD 中，由余弦定理：BD²=x²+t²−2xt cos42°。在三角形 ACD 中，由余弦定理：CD²=y²+t²−2yt cos42°。由 BD=CD，得 x²+t²−2xt cos42°=y²+t²−2yt cos42°，化简为 (x−y)(x+y−2t cos42°)=0。图示为单交点非退化情形，不取 x=y 的重合情形，因此取 x+y=2t cos42°。

在三角形 ABC 中，BC²=x²+y²−2xy cos84°。令 c=cos42°，由 x+y=2tc 得 t=(x+y)/(2c)。代入 BD²=x²+t²−2xtc，可得 BD²=x²+(x+y)²/(4c²)−x(x+y)=(x+y)²/(4c²)−xy。因此 4c²BD²=(x+y)²−4c²xy=x²+y²+2xy−4c²xy。又 cos84°=2cos²42°−1=2c²−1，所以 BC²=x²+y²−2xy cos84°=x²+y²−4c²xy+2xy=(x+y)²−4c²xy。于是 BC²=4c²BD²，即 BC=2BD cos42°。

在等腰三角形 BDC 中，BD=CD。设 θ=∠BDC，则底边 BC=2BD sin(θ/2)。与 BC=2BD cos42° 比较，得 sin(θ/2)=cos42°=sin48°。因为 θ/2 是三角形内角的一半，位于 0° 到 90° 之间，所以 θ/2=48°，从而 θ=96°。因此 ∠BDC=96°。

推理：已知 ∠BAC=84°，且 AD 是角平分线，所以 ∠BAD=∠DAC=42°。设 AB=x，AC=y，AD=t。因为 D 在 BC 的垂直平分线上，所以 BD=CD。

在三角形 ABD 中，由余弦定理：BD²=x²+t²−2xt cos42°。在三角形 ACD 中，由余弦定理：CD²=y²+t²−2yt cos42°。由 BD=CD，得 x²+t²−2xt cos42°=y²+t²−2yt cos42°，化简为 (x−y)(x+y−2t cos42°)=0。图示为单交点非退化情形，不取 x=y 的重合情形，因此取 x+y=2t cos42°。

在三角形 ABC 中，BC²=x²+y²−2xy cos84°。令 c=cos42°，由 x+y=2tc 得 t=(x+y)/(2c)。代入 BD²=x²+t²−2xtc，可得 BD²=x²+(x+y)²/(4c²)−x(x+y)=(x+y)²/(4c²)−xy。因此 4c²BD²=(x+y)²−4c²xy=x²+y²+2xy−4c²xy。又 cos84°=2cos²42°−1=2c²−1，所以 BC²=x²+y²−2xy cos84°=x²+y²−4c²xy+2xy=(x+y)²−4c²xy。于是 BC²=4c²BD²，即 BC=2BD cos42°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, the perpendicular bisector of BC intersects with the angle bisector of $\angle BAC$ at point D, with the foot of the perpendicular being point P. If $\angle BAC=84^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle BDC$?
raw_record.answer:
extbf{Solution:} Construct DE $\perp$ AB at point E, extending through AB, and DF $\perp$ AC at F,

since AD is the bisector of $\angle$BAC,

therefore DE = DF,

since DP is the perpendicular bisector of BC,

therefore BD = CD,

In right triangles $	riangle$DEB and $	riangle$DFC,

$\left\{ egin{array}{l}DB=DC\ DE=DF\end{array}ight.$,

therefore right $	riangle$DEB $\cong$ right $	riangle$DFC (HL).

therefore $\angle$BDE = $\angle$CDF,

therefore $\angle$BDC = $\angle$EDF,

since $\angle$DEB = $\angle$DFC = $90^\circ$,

therefore $\angle$EAF + $\angle$EDF = $180^\circ$,

since $\angle$BAC = $84^\circ$,

therefore $\angle$BDC = $\angle$EDF =  oxed{96^\circ},

The problem gives ∠BAC=84°.
Reasoning: Construct DE⊥AB at E and DF⊥AC at F according to the method. Because D is on the angle bisector of ∠BAC, the perpendicular distances from D to AB and AC are equal, namely DE=DF. Also because D is on the perpendicular bisector of BC, DB=DC. In right triangles DEB and DFC, the hypotenuses DB=DC and the right sides DE=DF, therefore the two right triangles are congruent by HL. Thus ∠BDE=∠CDF, so ∠BDC and ∠EDF can be made to correspond, obtaining ∠BDC=∠EDF. In quadrilateral AEDF, ∠AED=90° and ∠AFD=90°, so ∠EAF+∠EDF=180°. Also ∠EAF=∠BAC=84°, so ∠EDF=180°−84°=96°. Therefore ∠BDC=96°.
